children: Dividend alert, Sept. 24 -- Shares of PTC India ended marginally lower on Thursday ahead of its upcoming dividend record date. The power trading solutions provider is scheduled to pay 55% dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
The company has announced a total of Rs.26 dividend over the last twelve months. For investors who are interested in the company's corporate action, here are all the details to know.

The company has announced a 55% dividend for FY26. Its board of directors has approved a final dividend of Rs.5.50 per equity share with a face value of Rs.10 each. The board has recommended a "Final dividend of 55%, ie Rs. 5.5 per share for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026, to the shareholders for their approval."

The company has fixed Wednesday, October 7 as the record date for its upcoming dividend of 55% of its face value. PTC India's board of directors had approved a final dividend of Rs.5.5 per equity share with a face value of Rs.10 each. The board had recommended its latest dividend on May 19, 2026.
Power trading firm, PTC India, has a dividend yield of 14.85%. It has announced a total of Rs.26 dividend in one year.

The stock closed 1.02% lower at Rs.155.55 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.4,604.41 crore on Thursday, September 24. THe company scrip touched an intraday high of Rs.157.75 per share and an intraday low of Rs.155.00 per share. The stock touched its 52-week high of Rs.229.40 per share on May 7, 2026. It dipped to its 52-week low of Rs.149.90 per share on January 21, 2026.
Its share price value has declined 15.8% in three months and around 4.5% in 2026 so far. The stock has surged 15.69% in three years and around 58.32% in five years.
